description: This file is a markdown documentation describing the `FileChooser` class in Playwright, including its methods, event handling, and usage examples in multiple programming languages.

classes.name: FileChooser
classes.description: Represents a file chooser dialog in Playwright, dispatched during the `Page.fileChooser` event. Provides methods to get associated elements, check if multiple file selection is allowed, access the page it belongs to, and set selected files.

methods.name: element
methods.description: Returns the input element associated with this file chooser.

methods.name: isMultiple
methods.description: Returns whether this file chooser accepts multiple files.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Returns the page this file chooser belongs to.

methods.name: setFiles
methods.description: Sets the value of the file input this chooser is associated with. Accepts file paths, which are resolved relative to the current working directory. Passing an empty array clears the selected files.
